header.description: I’m a Full Stack Software Developer with commercial experience in React, TypeScript, NestJS, Node.js and MySQL. My path into software development has been gradual and consistent. Before moving fully into engineering, I spent several years in academic research and six years in professional sports analytics. This background shaped the way I work today: I’m highly analytical, data-driven and comfortable translating complex requirements into practical solutions. I’m based in Berlin, with professional English and advanced German currently progressing towards C1.

about.title: About
about.p1: I'm a Full Stack Developer based in Berlin, working mainly with React, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS and MySQL.
about.p2: My path into software development has been gradual rather than accidental. I was interested in computing and programming early on, later studied Computer Science alongside my professional career, and started using Python to automate repetitive analytical work long before moving fully into software development. Today I work commercially across frontend, backend and database layers. At Sensorfarm, I'm involved in modernising a legacy Java/JSP transaction platform into a React and NestJS application. My work includes REST API development, relational data modelling, database migrations, JWT-based authentication, password recovery and interactive analytics features.
about.p3: I also have hands-on experience with Docker, GitHub Actions, CI/CD and AWS. In my own CodaSk project, I have worked across the full application lifecycle, including frontend and backend development, authentication, API documentation and deployment using AWS services such as Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront and Route 53.
about.p4: What makes my background different is what came before software engineering.
about.p5: I hold a PhD in Physical Culture Sciences (Sport Science) and spent several years in academic research, working with experimental and biomechanical data, analytical methods and independent research projects. Later, I spent six years in professional volleyball analytics, including Germany’s Bundesliga, the CEV Champions League and Poland’s top division.
about.p6: In those roles, I worked closely with coaching teams to turn complex performance data into practical recommendations under short competition cycles. I also developed Python and VBA automations to reduce repetitive data-processing work and improve analytical workflows.
about.p7: That experience still shapes how I approach software today. I enjoy understanding complex problems, structuring data, translating requirements into practical solutions and improving processes through technology.
about.p9: React | TypeScript | JavaScript | Node.js | NestJS | MySQL | PostgreSQL | MongoDB | REST APIs | SQL | Data Modelling | Docker | GitHub Actions | CI/CD | AWS | Jest | React Testing Library | Python
about.p10: I'm currently looking for Full Stack Developer / Full Stack Engineer opportunities in Germany, ideally in Berlin. I'm also open to remote roles with companies in Poland and across Europe.
about.p12: Polish native | English professional proficiency | German advanced, currently completing C1-level training.

sensorfarm.title: Full Stack Web Developer
sensorfarm.desc: Worked on two distinct project. Initially involved in a strongly frontend leaning map based project where I developed interactive dashboard to manage operations being managed on the map. Also had a minor contribution to Java Spring Boot based backend and PostgreSQL database. Currently leading migration from a legacy Java/JSP application to NestJS/React. Also developed and implemented secure authentication flows using passport-auth and JWT tokens, including token rotation. Built email based password reset feature, and developed interactive dashboard using React Grid Layout

codac.title: Full Stack Web Developer
codac.desc: Full-Time on site coding bootcamp covering 840h of practical project based work in SCRUM methodology.

brv.title: Game analyst
brv.desc: As a game analyst, I collected and analyzed data to develop game strategies, working closely with the coaching staff. Recognizing opportunities for automation in my workflow, I used Python together with its rich data processing and visualisation libraries. This led to a more efficient workflow, reducing time spent on manual data analysis and enabling faster decision-making for the team.

dg.title: Game analyst
dg.desc: As a game analyst, I collected and analyzed data to develop strategies, and presented insights to the team.

awf.title: Technician
awf.desc: As a technician, I supported scientific projects by collecting, pre-processing, and visualizing data using Python and Excel. I collaborated with research teams to ensure data accuracy and streamline processes, resulting in more efficient data analysis.

projects.title: PROJECTS
projects.Codask: Collaborative project that aims to serve as an educational platform for students, graduates and mentors at Code Academy Berlin. It is designed to provide an opportunity for students to post questions related to coding challenges they face while learning at Code-Academy. Users can browse previously posted questions, offer solutions to other students through comments, and post new questions.
projects.ForkIt: Culinary app for people looking for new recipes and dishes to try. It relies on Spoonacular API to browse recipes from different cuisines and dish types. Users can browse recipes by categories, create own account and save favourite recipes.

footer: And finally the project you are currently looking at. It was built with NextJS. Styled with TailwindCSS, and deployed on Vercel. Hope you like it!
